# netskope_aig_appliance (Data Source)

Manages an AI Gateway (AIG) appliance in a Netskope tenant. AIG appliances proxy AI provider and MCP server traffic through Netskope for inspection, policy enforcement, and observability.

After creation the appliance is in `not-registered` status. Use the `aig_appliance_enrollment_token` resource to generate an enrollment token for registering the appliance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netskope_aig_appliance" "my_aigappliance" {
  id = "019c88b6-a197-70a2-9122-435a8e4af4cb"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the appliance (used as the Terraform resource ID).

### Read-Only

- `ai_provider_ids` (List of String) List of AI provider IDs associated with this appliance.
- `certificate_imported` (Boolean) Whether a TLS certificate has been imported onto the appliance.
- `host` (String) Hostname or FQDN of the appliance.
- `mcp_server_ids` (List of String) List of custom MCP server IDs associated with this appliance.
- `name` (String) Display name for the appliance.
- `ports` (Attributes) HTTP and HTTPS port configuration for the appliance. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ports))
- `sku_addons` (Attributes List) SKU add-ons (capacity packs) attached to this appliance. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sku_addons))
- `status` (String) Registration status of the appliance.

<a id="nestedatt--ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ports`

Read-Only:

- `http` (Attributes) Configuration for a single port (HTTP or HTTPS). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ports--http))
- `https` (Attributes) Configuration for a single port (HTTP or HTTPS). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ports--https))

<a id="nestedatt--ports--http"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ports.http`

Read-Only:

- `enable` (Boolean) Whether this port is enabled.
- `port` (Number) Port number.


<a id="nestedatt--ports--https"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ports.https`

Read-Only:

- `enable` (Boolean) Whether this port is enabled.
- `port` (Number) Port number.



<a id="nestedatt--sku_addons"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sku_addons`

Read-Only:

- `product_code` (String) Product code for the add-on SKU.
- `quantity` (Number) Number of capacity packs to attach (minimum 1).
